evidence.quote: inflation readings in the first quarter of this year were disappointing.
This means that we will need to allow our restrictive policy some further time to continue to do its work.
I think we are in a good position to hold steady and closely watch how conditions evolve.
Starting with recent economic developments, I see the performance of our economy as strong.
I remain vigilant to the risks to achieving both components of our mandate.

parsed.rationale: The short monetary policy section notes disappointing inflation readings, a strong economy, and the need to hold restrictive policy longer, which delays cuts and so leans moderately hawkish. Most of the speech covers bank regulation, so policy relevance is medium.
